summary: Phases 1 (PrimeTheory.lean, commit be8f2eb0) and 2a (CanonicalModel.lean definitions: CanonicalPrimeWorld, Preorder, canonicalVal, canonicalR; commit 4fd37213) remain green and untouched. Phase 2b (canonical_box_witness) is BLOCKED: partial progress established that {psi | box psi in w} is ModalSetConsistent (via a deductively-closed variant of derive_box_from_box_context plus a K-distribution+EFQ argument), but the prime extension via modal_prime_exclusion only secures canonicalR's box clause, not its diamond clause (every prime theory contains the bare theorem top, forcing dia-top in w.val as a precondition of canonicalR w v holding for ANY v -- a precondition not obviously discharged by the reported IK/CK axiom set without an explicit seriality-style axiom). blockers.description: Securing canonicalR's diamond clause (forall psi in v.val, dia psi in w.val) for a box-clause witness v requires dia-top in w.val as a precondition (since top is always in v.val for any deductively-closed v). Could not establish, from the reported IK/CK axiom set (K-box, K-dia, dia-bot->bot, dia(A or B)->diaA or diaB), that dia-top in w.val (or an equivalent seriality-style fact) is always available when box-phi not in w.val. Simpson 1994's own proof of the analogous F2 confluence fact (chunk_0223-0227) invokes an unidentified 'axiom 5 of IK' in a multi-step argument that could not be reconstructed with confidence from the available OCR (ambiguous box/diamond glyphs).
